releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.217: Signed APK includes the latest published Diary Web Update 457 bundle. Existing app identity, notes, photos, PINs, locks, widgets, reminders, and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 457: Personal Calendar saved entries now display the translated Repeat: Custom label correctly. Roman English shows Repeat: Custom instead of Dobara: repeatCustom. Smart Reminder labels and recurrence/alarm scheduling are unchanged.
